ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 6 — Preventive Visit — Annie Oakley

code.displayName: Periodic reevaluation and management of healthy individual

text.paragraph: Adult preventive visit; no new complaints. [S]

Mrs. Oakley returns for her preventive visit, three weeks after her five-month review. Her bladder infection in May cleared within two days of starting nitrofurantoin. She receives her monthly B12 injection from the practice nurse and takes iron every other day. Her energy is normal, she walks a mile a day, and she teaches two shooting classes a week. Her back pain is mild most days and she keeps up her home exercise program. She has had no falls. She completed the health risk assessment before the visit. [S]

Follow-up: Mammogram and DXA scan ordered; hepatitis C and HIV tests with the next blood draw. Monthly B12 injections with the practice nurse. Influenza and COVID-19 vaccines in the autumn. Pernicious anemia and iron review with a blood count and ferritin in three months. [S]

Voluntary advance care planning discussion of about 20 minutes, with her consent. She has named a health care agent and agreed to complete a written health care directive; a blank form was given today. She wants full treatment for any condition from which she could return to independent life and teaching. She would not want prolonged life support if she could not recover the ability to communicate. She will discuss these wishes with her agent and bring the completed form to her next visit. [S]
